name: The Centre At Preston Ridge
summary: The Centre at Preston Ridge is Frisco's go-to lifestyle destination featuring over 115 stores, shops, and restaurants in one convenient location. From big-box retailers and fashion chains to diverse dining options, this open-air center offers the best of everything for shoppers seeking variety and convenience.
demographics: The Centre at Preston Ridge attracts a diverse, affluent demographic typical of Frisco's rapidly growing population, with a strong presence of young families and professionals aged 25-54 with above-average household incomes exceeding $100,000. The trade area serves one of the fastest-growing cities in America, drawing visitors from surrounding North Dallas suburbs who seek convenient access to big-box retailers and casual dining options. Shopping patterns reflect a preference for one-stop convenience shopping, combining everyday necessities with fashion and home goods purchases, with peak traffic during evenings and weekends when families shop together.
description: The Centre at Preston Ridge stands as one of Frisco's premier shopping destinations, strategically located at the corner of Gaylord Parkway and Preston Road in the heart of this thriving North Texas community. This expansive lifestyle center brings together over 115 stores, shops, and restaurants under one convenient location, offering shoppers an unparalleled variety of retail experiences. From women's apparel and electronics to home furnishings and accessories, the center features a carefully curated mix of big-box retailers and popular chain fashion brands that cater to the diverse needs of Frisco's growing population. The dining scene is equally impressive, with restaurants offering flavors from around the world, making it easy to turn a shopping trip into a full day of entertainment. Open seven days a week, The Centre at Preston Ridge has established itself as a community gathering place where convenience meets variety, serving both local residents and visitors exploring everything Frisco has to offer.
